sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff Thu 7:15pm CT. Sold 40, 5,120 resting. Worst line -$31 (goal -$150).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): CHI by 1-6, CHI by 15+, NE by 1-6, NE by 7-14, NE by 15+.
CHI by 1-6: 40 behind. Crowd is quiet here (20 traded).
CHI by 15+: 40 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$31 is better than -$200.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$300.
Paid balancing starts Thu 6:30pm CT: worst line to -$150 by Thu 7:05pm CT, up to $100.
At Thu 6:45pm CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Thu 7:15pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
